top_signals.title: Indian Oil to Trim Term Deals With Gulf Producers For Next Year
top_signals.summary: Indian Oil Corp. plans to reduce the amount of crude purchased under term contracts with Middle Eastern producers next year, according to a person familiar with the matter, as attacks in the Persian Gulf continue to threaten supply routes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Netflix posts third-quarter earnings beat, but shares fall on advertising and revenue guidance
top_signals.summary: Wall Street and investors will be looking for Netflix to provide additional details about the company's strategy following recent organizational changes
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Boeing wins FAA approval for 737 Max 10 after years of delays as Duffy says certification process should be faster
top_signals.summary: The 737 Max 10, the largest model in the family, was set to start flying in 2020, but increased scrutiny and other safety issues delayed its certification.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Kroger’s Ex-CEO Defends Effort to Close Failed Albertsons Deal
top_signals.summary: Kroger Co.’s former chief executive officer testified in court that the grocery giant did what it was required to do to secure regulatory approval for a $24.6 billion merger with Albertsons Co., which is now demanding damages after the deal was blocked for antitrust reasons.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.summary: United Airlines cut its profit outlook for the year as fuel prices continued to climb.

top_signals.title: EU cyber law won’t force fixes for fridge controllers hit in French attack
top_signals.summary: The EU’s Cyber Resilience Act that took effect last month only requires companies to fix vulnerabilities and issue free updates during a product's support period, which manufacturers define.
